premises.text: Tiny web-page changes still require developers/agencies, high cost, and days or weeks of wait
premises.evidence_span: if you wanted to make even the slightest change to a page on the Web, like moving something one inch to the right, you better be willing to call a developer or agency, pay hundreds or thousands, and wait days or weeks

premises.text: Only a tiny share of people know HTML/CSS, so everyone else is stuck in rigid templates
premises.evidence_span: the people that know how to do this, all the HTML, CSS, they're less than 1% of the population. So that means the other 99%, at best, are able to fill in the blanks of a rigid paint-by-numbers template

premises.text: In-browser PageCloud editing gives PowerPoint-like creative freedom with instant live saves
premises.evidence_span: If you know how to use PowerPoint or Keynote or Photoshop, you already know how to use PageCloud

premises.text: Dragging third-party URLs onto the page creates live widgets such as video players and ticket commerce
premises.evidence_span: go to YouTube and grab that URL and drag it right to our page. We automatically get a fully functional YouTube player

premises.text: Mobile mode lets users reflow content so pages look right on phones
premises.evidence_span: Page Cloud dramatically simplifies the incredibly complex task of making Web pages mobile-friendly. Just enter mobile mode

premises.text: Designers can paste from Photoshop and copy existing pages into pixel-accurate editable PageCloud pages
premises.evidence_span: copy a poster image right out of Photoshop and paste it directly in our browser. Straight from Photoshop to the web

premises.text: Disrupt preorder price is $75 per year for a site
premises.evidence_span: get an amazing price of just $75 for the year for your site
